verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Human escalation and operational follow-through: all three escalation trigger categories are recognizable, the handoff payload explicitly carries transcript/account/intent/work done, and the queue, wait-target, callback, support-agent, and policy-review structures are present.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The board omits the system-defining requirement that the AI voice agent converses with the caller in real time; it also leaves the telephony-trunk boundary and conditional keypad fallback incomplete.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board substantially covers the identity/greeting flow, consent and intent stages, AI lookup/actions, human handoff payload, callback structure, and review-policy feedback loop. Coverage is reduced by the absent real-time conversation behavior and several partial constraints or conditions, including the trunk boundary, explicit account-context loading, noisy-audio keypad fallback, limited action scope, low-confidence risk semantics, universal recording coverage, and no-indefinite-hold qualifier.
